note: Livingston County MO zones unincorporated land, administered by the County Zoning Administrator in Chillicothe, but no queryable zoning district service was found. The assessor's GIS viewer (Midland GIS / integritygis) lists parcel and tax layers only; Chillicothe's official zoning map is filed with the Recorder of Deeds and its only published copy is a PDF (2019). ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Livingston County MO zoning returned nothing official. Regrid carries standardized zoning but is a commercial aggregator, not an official queryable service.
